integrity: Exact integer-polynomial transfer proof, independently structured exhaustive checks through ten columns and explicit Perron/analytic arguments; finite checks are not an all-width proof.
scientific_limitations: Original complementing Critters, labelled full-step fixed configurations, two-row periodic tori with even circumference at least four. The pre-1998 book was not completely inspectable; no historical uniqueness or external mathematical validation is asserted.
title: An occupation-resolved stationary zeta and Gaussian law for Critters on two-row tori
